reply:
Added recurring transactions
Details
Previewing

You can now tick Repeat monthly when you add or edit a transaction. It then shows up by itself in each later month you open, on the same day, or the last day of shorter months. A new Recurring link at the top lists every repeating item and lets you stop one from any month you pick. Months before that stay as they were.

While testing I found and fixed one bug: editing the Nov 30 copy of a payment set on the 31st moved all later months to the 30th. Later months now keep the 31st.

When you edit a repeating item, the change applies only to months you haven't opened yet. Months already opened keep their old copy, which you can edit on its own. Unticking Repeat monthly stops it from the next month.

What I tested and how

Automated tests: 27 pass, 11 of them new for repeating items:
The 31st becomes Apr 30, Feb 28, and Feb 29 in a leap year.
Opening a month three times still gives one copy.
A copy you delete doesn't come back.
Nothing appears in months before the first one.
Stopping from March keeps January and February and removes March onward.
Edits apply only to later months.
Ticking or unticking the box on an existing transaction starts or stops repeating.
Real browser at 1280px and 375px:
Added "Rent" on Oct 31 with Repeat monthly ticked.
It appeared on Nov 30 and on Feb 28 (2027).
Moving back and forth between months still showed one copy per month.
The box was still ticked when editing a copy, and everything was still there after a reload.
On the Recurring screen, stopped it from January 2027: Oct–Dec stayed, Jan and Feb were empty with totals at 0.00.
No sideways scrolling and no page errors at either size; I looked at screenshots of both.
Suggested goal for the app
People keep their spending within what they planned for each month.

Measured by: People who end a month with every budgeted category at or under budget, each month
